cases.question: How long do I have to request a refund?
cases.expected_answer: A refund can be requested within 30 calendar days of purchase.

cases.question: Are return shipping costs refunded for defective items?
cases.expected_answer: Original delivery charges are refunded only when an item is confirmed to be defective.

cases.question: When is express delivery available?
cases.expected_answer: Express delivery is available for eligible orders placed before 14:00 Central European Time on business days.

cases.question: How long does standard delivery take?
cases.expected_answer: Standard delivery usually takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch.

cases.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
cases.expected_answer: A subscription can be cancelled from Account > Subscription at any time.

cases.question: When does my subscription renew?
cases.expected_answer: The subscription renews automatically on the same calendar day each month unless cancelled.
